d: An anonymous recruiter sees accurate, concise GitHub About metadata, the requested topics, a visible v1.0.0 release, working HF/GitHub cross-links, accurate public cards/provenance, a working dataset viewer, and no irrelevant active deployments or packages.
allowed: update GitHub description, homepage, topics, supported repository presentation settings, and create or update the v1.0.0 release
update only Hugging Face dataset and adapter cards/provenance metadata and cross-links
commit and push presentation-only repository changes
perform anonymous profile, page, viewer, API, and link verification
write terminal canonical Notion and GitHub mirror state after verification
forbidden: modify frozen dataset bytes, labels, split membership, manifests, or scientific hashes
modify adapter weights or adapter configuration
training, inference, GPU/cloud work, new science, V2, benchmark change, force push, secret exposure, or secret persistence

v.github_about: anonymous API/page shows the chosen description, HF adapter homepage, and all eight requested topics
v.github_irrelevant_surfaces: no active deployments or public packages; unsupported hide controls are not fabricated
v.hugging_face: profile, dataset, adapter, cards, viewer, and cross-links resolve anonymously; dataset viewer remains valid
v.integrity: canonical dataset hashes and adapter LFS SHA-256 remain unchanged
v.links: all public landing/card/results/evidence links resolve anonymously

stop: CLOSED only after independent anonymous verification; otherwise BLOCKED at one exact external auth/provider failure.
